cases.explain: «прекрасным венком» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

cases.explain: «дорогих вещей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

cases.explain: «преступной добычи» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

cases.explain: «шумных улиц» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
